nodes.name: Patch Tuesday 22:00
nodes.notes: Fires on the 2nd Tuesday of each month at 22:00. Adjust the cron expression for your patch window.

nodes.name: Set Maintenance Window
nodes.notes: Sets a 6-hour maintenance window per group. Adjust startTime/endTime for your schedule.

nodes.name: Trigger Update Job
nodes.notes: Executes 'Windows Update - Critical Patches' job on each group's endpoints. Replace the Job ID with your actual Windows Update job definition GUID.

nodes.name: Get Job Results (by Job Def)
nodes.notes: Fetches only instances of YOUR patch job — not all jobs in the system. Replace the GUID with the same job definition ID used in 'Trigger Update Job'.

nodes.name: Send Report Email
nodes.notes: Configure your SMTP credentials. Or replace with Microsoft Teams / Slack node.
